title: 6.21.2 Check: the Sling game
description: Five multiple-choice questions on the arm, the launch, the sweep, the hit budget and the ending. Checked instantly.

questions.question: On screen, which way does rotation -90 point?
questions.explanation: Up is -90 on screen: 0 is right, 90 is down.

questions.question: Why is a shot made on mouse.released() rather than presses()?
options: The pull is complete when the button comes up
questions.explanation: The aim and power are only known once the player lets go.

questions.question: A shot gets direction = arm.rotation. Which way does it leave?
questions.explanation: Rotation and direction are the same unit and the same sense.

questions.question: A shot is off-screen but its entry is still in the array. What is missing?
questions.explanation: delete() removes the sprite; splice() removes the array entry. You need both.

questions.question: Why does a shot count one hit even though overlaps() is true for several frames?
options: overlaps() is false after one frame
The shot is deleted on the frame it hits
questions.explanation: Removing the shot is what makes the hit single.
